metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a C++20 CLI G-code simulator with RS274 execution, state output JSON, optional parameter/tool/probe inputs, and optional trace JSON sampling.

Changed files:
- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/CMakeLists.txt)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp)

What’s implemented:
- CLI flags: `--input`, `--output`, plus all optional flags you listed (`--tool-table`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`, `--parameter-input`, `--parameter-output`, `--probe-box`, `--probe-tool`, `--trace-output`, and exactly one trace stepping mode).
- RS274 parser and evaluator: words, parameter assignments, expressions, modal groups, execution order, and core error handling.
- Machine model/state tracking: position, feed/spindle/modal states, tools, offsets, coordinate systems, parameters.
- Motion execution: G0/G1/G2/G3, G4, G10, G28/G30, G38.2 probing with probe-box trip logic, G92 family, G53, G54–G59.3, G40/G41/G42, G43/G49, canned cycles G81–G89.
- Trace generation with line/time metadata and delta-state serialization.
- JSON output format and exit-code behavior per your requirements (success, spec-defined invalid input, internal error).
- Parameter-file read/write and tool-file read support (RS274 header/data split format).

Build verification:
- Ran successfully with:
  - `cmake -B build_root && cmake --build build_root`
- Also validated runtime with success and error smoke tests, including trace emission.
